mainEntity.name: How far is Mahakal Bhakta Nivas from Mahakaleshwar Temple?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are located just 200 metres (about a 3-minute walk) from the main Mahakaleshwar Temple gates. Our proximity makes it easy for devotees to attend morning and evening aartis without any travel hassle.

mainEntity.name: How can I reach Mahakal Bhakta Nivas from Ujjain Railway Station?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ujjain Railway Station is approximately 3 km away. Auto-rickshaws and local taxis are readily available (10–15 minutes). We can also arrange a pickup on request — just call us in advance.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide meals with the rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer pure vegetarian satvik meals as part of select packages. Guests can also enjoy our complimentary morning tea and prasadam. The on-site canteen serves local and North Indian cuisine.

mainEntity.name: What is the check-in and check-out time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard check-in time is 12:00 PM and check-out is 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged subject to availability — please contact us in advance.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer group or family booking discounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! We offer special rates for family groups, temple trusts, and large devotional groups. For groups of 10 or more, please contact us directly for custom packages.

mainEntity.name: Is parking available at the dharmashala?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we have dedicated parking space for two-wheelers and four-wheelers. Our premises are secured with CCTV surveillance for the safety of your vehicle.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), all major credit and debit cards. Online payments via our website booking engine are also supported.

mainEntity.name: Are there any nearby temples I should visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ujjain is one of the 12 Jyotirlinga sites and home to many sacred spots. Key temples near us include: Harsiddhi Temple (1 km), Ram Ghat (500 m), Gopal Mandir (1.5 km), and the famous Kumbh Mela site on the Shipra River.
